name: Senator Verdow
about: Senator Verdow is a member of Veridia's parliament who becomes Gladias's ally. The book does not describe his appearance beyond a parliament robe, so this look is invented and contributors are welcome to replace it.

facts.quote: Senator Verdow, you may ask your question.
Inside, he saw a man wearing a Veridian parliament robe.
facts.fact: Wears a Veridian parliament robe (not the privacy robe) at parliament.

facts.quote: with a facial expression and tone warmer than Gladias had ever heard him
Verdow stood up, and walked over slowly to a map of the world

descriptor: a man in his late fifties, tall and lean, medium brown skin, close-cropped white hair and a short white beard, warm deep-set eyes, wearing a long deep-green woven parliament robe with wide draped sleeves and a sculpted high collar fastened by a simple bronze clasp, over a cream seamless undertunic, a broad bronze-colored cloth sash, dark loose trousers and soft brown seamless shoes
sheet_prompt: Character reference sheet on a plain flat off-white background with no scenery: three full-body views of the same person side by side, front view facing the viewer, three-quarter view, and back view, neutral standing pose, even lighting. The person is a man in his late fifties, tall and lean, medium brown skin, close-cropped white hair and a short white beard, warm deep-set eyes, wearing a long deep-green woven parliament robe with wide draped sleeves and a sculpted high collar fastened by a simple bronze clasp, over a cream seamless undertunic, a broad bronze-colored cloth sash, dark loose trousers and soft brown seamless shoes.
costume_notes: Keeps the Veridian parliament robe from the book, now with draped sleeves, a sculpted collar and bronze sash in natural woven fibers.
